name: Blowup above alpha = 1/3 in viscous Katz–Pavlović dyadic models with small shell ratios
target: Finite-time blowup for five shell ratios from 6/5 to 9/5 and alpha up to 0.339–0.378
result: Proved with CAPD interval arithmetic; this is a model, not the Navier–Stokes equations.

notes.formal: Lean proves eight elementary lemmas; the interval computation is trusted to CAPD 6.1.0
notes.human: not yet refereed (Physica D package ready)
